title: REQ · Submit success feedback is targeted by its own test id in its test
summary: Success element has a test id and contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx uses it
description: The success paragraph (L153) shares role="status" with the loading and empty messages, so findByRole('status') in tests/contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx is ambiguous. Add data-testid="contribution-success" and make the test target it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful send, when submitted, then getByTestId contribution-success has text 'Suggestion sent'
Given a 429 error or an edit after success, then queryByTestId contribution-success is null
technical_constraints: vitest with mocked submitContribution and listMine
definition_of_done: Success test no longer queries by role status
